attribution_rule.lead_in_and_trailing_silence: The window's lead-in silence (clip 0-0.63 s, before the first sung word at song 18.60 s) and the trailing pause (clip after about 4.89 s) are outside the comparison section (plan section 4: 'I didn't run', 18.60-20.57 s) and outside the film window (clip 0.897-4.597 s). A mouth that is open there is the expected result of the approved plate A02 (open, singing pose; qa/gate-S8a found the same) and is recorded in the gate as such. It is not a stop condition.
attribution_rule.stop_conditions_kept: An objective FAIL inside the sung section or the film window (identity, deformation, on-screen text including the quoted lyric drawn as text, camera not locked, a second person) whose cause is a shared input stops the remaining units of the same prompt group; if the cause is the plate or the window (shared by both groups), all remaining units stop. An UNKNOWN outcome stops everything.
attribution_rule.lip_sync_accuracy: Unchanged: it is the measured variable, judged by the user on the review videos, not a stop condition.
